subject: ventures/einvoice-preflight
professional: an e-invoicing integration consultant who certifies ERP output against EN 16931, Peppol BIS 3.0 and XRechnung validators; first check: does the pre-screen agree to the cent with BR-CO-15/16/17, and are its identifier check digits the published algorithms

evidence.correctness: Scored independently. (1) Rounding, re-run today: node import of checks.mjs gives roundHalfUpToCents(1.5*19/100) = 0.28 and roundHalfUpToCents(1.005) = 1; exact half-up (decimal 0.285 -> 0.29, 1.005 -> 1.01, which is what EN 16931 BR-CO-15/17 arithmetic and the Python port's Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP give) differs. checks.mjs:30-34 and linenet.mjs:15-19 still use Math.round(abs*100 + Number.EPSILON); git log shows no commit touching them since 2026-11-07 (the only einvoice-preflight commit since is #14235, VAT). (2) Differential test against a separate reference I wrote in Python from published algorithms, 1,200 random identifiers fed through inspectPartyVat, accept/reject compared on INV-023: DE (BZSt ISO 7064 MOD 11,10), NO organisasjonsnummer (Brreg weights 3,2,7,6,5,4,3,2, check 10 never issued), CZ 10-digit rodne cislo (first nine mod 11, remainder 10 -> 0, month +20/+50/+70, day 1-31), IT partita IVA (Luhn variant, per Agenzia delle Entrate): 1,200 of 1,200 agree (87 valid, 1,113 invalid). (3) New work #14235 (BG 10-digit EGN weights 2,4,8,5,10,9,7,3,6 mod 11, 10 -> 0, and CZ rodne cislo) matches the published rules. Not recomputed this round beyond the above: IBAN, Leitweg (agreed in the 11-07 audit). Correctness stays 2 because the primary-path JS rounding defect found two days ago is still present: a correct 1.50 net at 19% with tax 0.29 draws a false INV-018 in the browser page and API.
evidence.completeness: Claims exercised: JSON/UBL/CII/Factur-X readers, INV-001..035, IBAN/BIC/VAT/period/means/terms/remittance, profiles, repair, generate, FatturaPA/FA(3)/ZATCA/India, ~70 country mandate pages with tests, ICS calendar. All suites pass (below). BG/CZ 10-digit check digits are ported to both vat.mjs and src/einvoice_preflight/vat.py (_bg_ten, _cz_birth) and work end to end. Limits the README states and I confirm: Schematron route skipped without slimdom/fontoxpath (50 tests), PDF/A unrun, Python CLI lacks profiles. Norway/Switzerland VAT (#14052) still exists only in JS. No stubs found.
evidence.verification: Ran `node --test '*.test.mjs'` in ventures/einvoice-preflight: 1360 tests, 1310 pass, 0 fail, 50 skipped (Schematron/CIUS cross-check not exercised without slimdom/fontoxpath). `python -m pytest -q tests` with PYTHONPATH=src: 359 passed, 53 subtests. Mutations, each reverted with git checkout (tree clean apart from another auditor's untracked file): (1) vat.mjs czBirthNumberOk `(n % 11) % 10` -> `(n % 11)` (remainder 10 no longer maps to 0): vat.test.mjs 28 pass, 0 fail, the mutation SURVIVED,. (2) vat.mjs bgTenDigitOk `if (egn === 10) egn = 0` -> `= 1`: full 1360-test suite passed, SURVIVED. Both are the 'remainder 10' branches of the new #14235 code, which has no test with a remainder-10 number. Prior survivors (INV-011 boundary 11-07, mod11Check check-10 guard 11-08) were not re-run; the half-cent rounding defect still passes every test and JS/Python still have no shared fixture corpus.
evidence.craft: Read checks.mjs:1-40, linenet.mjs:10-25, vat.mjs:67-200 and 677-693, and the Python vat.py BG/CZ entries. Positives: BG/CZ code is compact, commented with the rule it implements, and was ported to Python in the same PR (parity improved vs 11-08). Defects: float rounding unfixed two days after being reported, in two duplicate copies (checks.mjs and linenet.mjs); roundHalfUpToCents and roundCents are copy-pasted; NO/CH VAT checks absent from the Python port (the parity gap from 11-08 persists); three structures for country checks (EXTRA_CHECKS table, inline chains, FORMAT_ONLY); README is 116 KB, a run log; ~70 templated country pages and tests committed as source. Repeating a reported defect is weighed here, so craft drops from 3 (11-07) to 2.
evidence.claims: checks.mjs:1-3 still claims the browser page and CLI report 'the same rule IDs, messages, and cent-rounded arithmetic': false for half-cent ties (JS 0.28 vs Python Decimal 0.29, shown above) and for NO/CH VAT findings (JS only). Reported on 11-07 and 11-08, no change to header or README. Honest items re-confirmed: observation not the KoSIT validator, VENTURE.yaml stage prototype with untested hypotheses, disclaimer in index.html and llms.txt, VAT checks described as from public descriptions (my differential test agrees with them).
evidence.fitness: A bookkeeper or ERP integrator can drop in UBL/CII/JSON and get rule IDs with fixes; VAT check coverage now spans DE, FR, NL, IT, ES, AT, BE, NO, CH, BG, CZ and more, usable for pre-screening. Limits: roughly 1 in 1,000 tax computations can false-flag in the browser/API path, Python CLI users get no NO/CH check, and the authoritative Schematron route is opt-in and needs a build.
evidence.domain: Identifier algorithms match the registers' published rules (Brreg, BZSt, Agenzia delle Entrate, Bulgarian EGN, Czech rodne cislo). EN 16931 BR-CO-15/16/17 arithmetic is right except tie rounding; per-rate grouping is correct. Positioning as a pre-screen with the official Schematron as authority is what a consultant would accept. Departure: ties rounded by binary float rather than decimal half-up, which the standard's arithmetic does not allow.

defects.what: Unfixed since 2026-11-07 (third audit): roundHalfUpToCents/roundCents use Math.round(abs*100 + Number.EPSILON). 1.5*19/100 = 0.285 returns 0.28 (exact 0.29), 1.005 returns 1 (exact 1.01). Correct invoices draw false INV-018/INV-012/INV-014 in the browser page and API; the Python port (Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP) does not.

Header claim that the page and CLI report the same rule IDs, messages and cent-rounded arithmetic is false (rounding ties; NO/CH VAT findings only in JS) and has been reported twice without a change; no shared JS/Python fixture test.
New #14235 code has untested remainder-10 branches: changing the BG EGN `egn === 10 -> 0` rule, or the CZ `% 10` mapping, passes the whole 1360-test suite (two mutations survived).
Norway and Switzerland VAT check digits (#14052) are still absent from the Python port.

Carried over: 50 Schematron/CIUS tests skip without slimdom/fontoxpath; INV-011 boundary and mod11Check check-10 guard mutations survived earlier audits (not re-run); README is a 116 KB run log; templated country pages committed as source.

verdict: Third audit in three days. New work (BG/CZ 10-digit VAT check digits, ported to both engines) is correct: a 1,200-identifier differential test against my own reference implementations of the DE, NO, CZ and IT algorithms agreed on every case, and 1310 JS and 359 Python tests pass. But the main defect from 2026-11-07, half-cent ties rounded by binary float in checks.mjs and linenet.mjs (0.285 -> 0.28), is still unfixed, so the page and API can reject a correct invoice and the stated JS/Python parity claim remains false. Two seeded mutations in the new remainder-10 branches survived the full suite. Does not meet the bar (correctness 2, verification 2, claims 2). Scores are before any fix; the fix is a few lines (integer cents or decimal-string rounding) plus a tie-case test.
